name: Don N. Holt Bridge
elevationDatum: Local y=0 is the flat foundation datum, not sea level. Main roadway 52 m, underside 49.8 m; approach grades and exposed pier heights are estimates. Metres east/up/south; mapped 99.6 degree bearing baked once. No DEM or Mercator scale.
note: 1992 three-span continuous through-Warren truss, current muted Citadel-blue paint. SCDOT: approximately 2 miles overall and 155 ft navigation clearance. OSM: about 491 m truss and 29.4 m envelope; nominal 244 m main span and 28.5 m road deck treated as estimates pending engineering drawings. Model 3330 m overall, 20 Warren panels; estimated truss depth 21 m and approach grades. No exit ramps, lamps, signage or traffic; library-only, no road fitting.
